## Publication Information

**Date:** 1865

**Imprint:** London: Macmillan

**Notes:** CMY reviewed this in both <i>Macmillan's Magazine</i> and the <i>Literary Churchman</i>, but did not mention it in <i>MP</i>, perhaps because she considered the subject unsuitable for the young.
